_comment: Daily focus override. Set 'metric' to bias the safety rotation toward it (~40% of sends). Comma-separate for MULTIPLE (the 40% splits across them), e.g. 'cdf, speeding'. Valid: speeding | sign/signal | following distance | seatbelt | distraction | cdf | pod | dcr. Optional 'until' = YYYY-MM-DD it expires (omit = until you change it). Leave metric empty/blank to turn focus off.
